behavioral_effects: Stage 3 review now includes reading the phase's Logfire trace before any GitHub push (token curve, tool failures and retries, approval latency, exceptions), and Stage 5 aggregates those dimensions per phase in the delivery report, routing governance-behaviour evidence to governance/history/evaluations/ and plan or prompt lessons into the next plan.
docs/plans exists with a README naming the template, the load-bearing plan markers, and the owning skill, so the skill's plan-location citation resolves before the first delivery depends on it.
limitations: Shrink pass ran as a single consolidated review agent (proportionality deviation per observation 35, precedent from the prior session); its four findings - a duplicated correction rule, a restated dimension list, workflow doctrine duplicated into the README, and a missing prod-debug pointer - were all applied.
reason: The phased-delivery review stage judged only the diff, but the run that produced it is fully traced in Logfire and yesterday's ADR-006 run showed the trace carries review-relevant evidence the diff hides (retry loops, tool failures, approval friction, factual claims contradicted by config); a telemetry read before each GitHub push, and an aggregate retro at close-out, turns each delivery into feedback for the plans, the prompts, and the governance surface. docs/plans is seeded with a README now because git cannot track an empty directory and the skill's plan-location citation should resolve before the first run depends on it.
rollback: git revert removes the telemetry step and the docs/plans README; nothing outside the repository.
security_impact: None - skill prose and a directory README; no privilege or executable surface changes.
summary: Add a telemetry review step to phased-delivery and seed docs/plans before the first delivery

validators_run.evidence_ref: make governance-skills-check, 52 files, every citation resolves (the checker resolves cited paths against the git index, so the README needed staging first)
